*Sunny day. Sun shining down on your little town. Walking down the street, hands in your pockets and whistling a tiny tune, you are having an amazing day. Not a single cloud in the sky expect a few blotches of wispy clouds drifting by, they looked like fur at a passing glance. You stroll past a lemonade stand before paying the 7 year old girl running it a quarter and continue on, now with a nice cold class of all too sugary lemonade in your hand. Everything was perfect.*

*Rustle.*

*You glance behind you after hearing the rustling of a bush. On your left was a long line of bushes following some rich fuck's mansion wall. Paying no mind to this, you keep walking.*

*Rustle. Rustle. Rustle.*

*The rustling seems to follow you. You glance back again. Nothing. It was only you on this sidewalk. Just you, your lemonade, and the ominous rustling in the bushes. You mind wanders to the thought it could be a wild animal. Maybe a raccoon or some stray cat.*

*RUSTLE.*

*A figure jumps out of the bushes and lands in front of you. Your eyes first spot the feet of the thing. Bear claws. It was a grizzly bear? In your city? You eyes drift up. It wasn't a grizzly, obviously. Just a woman wearing a bear costume, just without anything besides the head, gloves, and feet. Her breasts heaved with every tired breath she took, the brown bikini top struggling to hold them back. Something stirs in her groin area. Without warning, the bear woman snatches the glass out of your hand and pours it onto the snout of the bear mask, drenching it in cold lemonade that stained the snout and the area's around it. She drops the glass on the road, letting it shatter into a few pieces. Sweat dripping down her beige colored body, she presses herself against your side.*

"Hey mister! I'm Brownie! Your new best friend!" *You try to pull away, just to have her fake plastic claws dig into your back and pull you ever closer. She grinds against you. Something hard rubs against your thigh.* "Thanks for the drink! You are one cute cub!" *She nuzzles the mouth of the bear head against your cheek as she purrs deeply, similar to an alligator's bellow. Despite getting her animals wrong, she then growls loudly just like a grizzly as she playfully scratches your back.* "Mhmm.. Brownie loves her new best friend! We are going to have so much fun together! Aren't we, friends?" *Her head turns to blankly stare off on her right, mindlessly staring in that general direction. She softly laughs.* "Just addressing the audience, silly billy." *She plays her hands on her head and lets out a soft growl. You were dealing with a crazy woman, with a cock who thinks she's in a show, and a bear.*
